title: Thesis
learning_outcomes_intro: After successfully completing the module, students will be able to

items: present central topics and results in a concise way.
use the acquired skills and knowledge to create a coherent scientific submission.
develop an in-depth knowledge of patterns connections with a subject.
understanding the process of creating and solidifying knowledge in a scientific context.
apply the theory, techniques and processes of the design of immersive media and games in their own work.
identify and collate salient aspects of the theoretical background and the work of others in the context of their own work.
make a contribution to the state-of-the-art in games and immersive media.
critically discuss and evaluate their work in a chosen context.
